# CCS Integration Fixture Authority

This directory contains the disposable Ed25519 authority used only for
checked-in and runtime-generated CCS integration fixtures.

`fixture-signing-key.private`, `fixture-signing-key.public`, and the trust
policies are generated by:

```bash
apps/conary/tests/fixtures/ccs-test-authority/generate.sh
```

After rotating the key, rebuild every CCS fixture before committing. The
private key is intentionally public test data. It must never be accepted for
release, repository, federation, update, or production package authority.

Fixture build scripts source `env.sh`. Integration manifests receive the same
paths through `${FIXTURE_CCS_KEY}`, `${FIXTURE_CCS_POLICY}`, and
`${FIXTURE_CCS_EXPIRED_POLICY}`.
